meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 它会给项目生成一套分层 AGENTS.md 知识库：先测量仓库、按复杂度给目录打分，再写出根目录和达标子目录的文件，内容涵盖结构、命令与约定，最后逐个校验。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录成文档供 agent 使用时，或你运行 /init-deep 时接管；可加 --create-new、--max-depth 等参数。

say.text: /init-deep 帮我给这个项目生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 更新已有文件，并在需要处新建
先读旧文件，再全部删除后重建

howto.what_en: It builds a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base: it measures the repo, scores directories, writes root and qualifying subdirectory AGENTS.md files covering structure, commands, and conventions, then verifies each file.
howto.when_en: Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents, or when you run /init-deep (options include --create-new and --max-depth).

say_en.note: Updates existing files, creates new where warranted
Reads existing files, deletes all, rebuilds
